newsitem.title: USA: Prodi describes early June CPI data as excellent.
newsitem.headline: Prodi describes early June CPI data as excellent.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said Friday that his country's early consumer price index data for June was "excellent" and provided tangible evidence of the prospects for economic recovery.
"The CPI data is excellent," Prodi, here for the Group of Seven meeting, told reporters.
"Whoever thought that Italy's fight against inflation was temporary was wrong," he said.
"The data show the prospects for economic recovery are tangible," adding that the fight against inflation must precde the fight against unemployment.
"There is an ongoing recovery, it is gaining pace."
Prodi also said Italy's discount rate was abnormally high but lowering it was a task for the Bank of Italy.
"Bank of Italy and the government know their respective duties and limits and respect them."

Treasury Minister Azeglio Ciampi later told reporters that the early CPI data showed a 0.1 percent increase in June over May and if confirmed would lead to a 1.5 percent CPI increase for June, year-over-year.
